text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} arrives at the field as usual, only to find
Mifuyu with an uncharacteristically grim look on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつものように平原に呼び出された{0}。
だが、ミフユはやけに深刻な顔をしていた。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming, {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text: よく来てくれたわね、{0}くん……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've had something on my mind for a while now.
Today... I'm challenging you to a duel!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こないだからずっと考えていたんだけど……
今日はキミに、
勝負を挑むわ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I don't know why... But I've felt a little strange lately.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わからないけど……
最近、
私変なのよ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm around you, I can't seem to think straight!
Like I keep going overboard trying to impress you...
But then it's [i]me[/i] that ends up relying on [i]you[/i] in the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キミがそばにいると、
平常心でいられなくなったの！
いいところを見せようと
無理しちゃうようになったし……
かと思いきや、
甘えたり、
頼りにしたくなっちゃうときもあるし。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I just find myself wanting to be with you for no real reason.
I've never felt this way before. It's so... inefficient.
So... I need to overcome you and get back to being myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
理由もなくキミとただ一緒にいたいなんて……
こんな気持ち初めてで、
全然効率的じゃないわ。
だから……
キミを打ち倒して、
本来の私に戻るわっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Let's do this, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text: いくわよ、{0}くんっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You blocked it?
Okay then, try this on for size!
text_block_list.orig_text:
受け止めた……？
なら、
これはどうかしら！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Parried that one, too, eh... You've really improved!
I'm happy to see it! Hyaaahh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また、
返した……
腕を上げたわね！
嬉しいわ！　
でええええええい！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After a long bout with no real winner,
the two fall to the ground in exhaustion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それから、長い戦いの果てに決着はつかず、
二人は同時に力尽きて地面に倒れ込んだ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ungh! Whew. I think we've both had enough for today.
I'm really impressed, {0}.
I couldn't get the best of you... which makes this a draw.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っぷはあっ！　
ふう。
もう今日はおしまいにしましょう。
腕を上げたわね、
{0}くん。
決着はつかなかった……
勝負は持ち越し。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll keep training you as I have been for now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
師弟関係も、
とりあえずは継続ってことで。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Heheheh. Thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ。
ありがとうね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hey... I wonder if... I could open up to you
about a few things?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえ……
少しだけ……
自分語りにつきあってもらってもいい……？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
See, I haven't really had any close friends, boy or girl.
Not that I don't get along with my guildmates,
but a lot of that is just built on us working together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
今までね……
男性とも女性とも、
あまり仲良く
なってこなかったわ。
ギルドメンバーとも仲は悪くないけど、
半分くらいは仕事ってこともあるし。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Being a mercenary is all about being efficient, which means
I'm a loner by necessity. Having to look out for others is a weakness.
...Or so I've always told myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それもこれも、
効率を考えると、
傭兵は孤独でないと
いけない。
守るものができちゃったら弱くなる。
……そう勝手に思っていたのね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Is it all right if I scoot over closer to you?
You can stay lying where you are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ……
ちょっとだけそっちに寄ってもいい？
寝ころんだままでいいから……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...
{0}, I have a piece of cloth here.
Care to guess what it is?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ……{0}くん。
ここに、
一枚の布切れがあります。
……これ、
なんだと思う？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Is that what it looks like?
text_block_list.orig_text: そう見える？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Well yeah, it certainly is, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
そうだけど……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this is from a while ago, back when my clothes
got ripped while fighting monsters, and you lent me your cape
to cover myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……これはね、
いつだったか、
魔物との戦いで
私の服が破れた時に、
体を隠せってキミにもらったマント。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well, all I have left is this tattered little piece
that doesn't serve any purpose to keep...
But for some reason, I can't throw it away. Weird, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうボロボロになっちゃったこんな布きれを
まだ
持ってるなんて、
全然効率的じゃないけど……
なんだか、
手放せないの。
変、
かな？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hehehe... Thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ……
ありがと。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hearing you say that makes me feel happy, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言ってくれて、
私も……
嬉しいわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}.
If you ever do beat me in real duel...
If I ever stop being your teacher, do you think...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、{0}くん。
もしこの先、
キミが本当に私に勝ったとして……
師弟関係じゃなくなったら、
キミは……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Do you think you would still... stay by my side?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでも、私のそばに……
いてくれるのかな？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Eheheh. Thank you, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
ありがとうね、
{0}くん。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
All right, then tomorrow let's you and I tackle this
dungeon-delving job I have lined up!
We'll aim to finish it in the shortest time possible!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
それじゃあ明日は依頼を受けてる
ダンジョン探索、
一緒に行きましょう！
最短時間での完了を
目指すわよーーー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu and {0} naturally put their arms around each
other's shoulders as they spoke, their bond clearly growing 
into one far stronger than that of a teacher and student.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言いながら、自然と肩を組むミフユと{0}。
きっと二人は、ただの師弟関係よりも
強い絆で結ばれていくことだろう……
